assets.title: Published beach–peach continuum: step 1 of 9
assets.scope: Published beach–peach word continuum, Kim et al. (2025)
assets.note: Actual beach–peach stimulus file from the public materials for Kim, McMurray, Sorensen, and Oleson (2025). Natural American-English recordings were manipulated by progressive cross-splicing in Praat. The published endpoint recordings differ in both VOT (reported as 4 vs 45 ms) and vowel duration (146 vs 107 ms), so this is not labeled a pure VOT-only continuum. Archive step numbers are preserved; per-step VOT has not been inferred from the file names. These are not the original McMurray et al. (2003) or Eimas et al. (1971) recordings.
assets.source_reference: Kim, H., McMurray, B., Sorensen, E., & Oleson, J. (2025). The consistency of categorization-consistency in speech perception. Psychonomic Bulletin & Review, 32, 2246–2258.
